question: Which city hosted the 2022 commonwealth games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Birmingham.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Commonwealth Games** is a **multi-sport event** that takes place **every four years** and involves **athletes **from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• **Greenwich** is a district in **southeast London,** but it **did not** host the 2022 Commonwealth Games.
 
• **London** hosted the **2012 Summer Olympics**, but it **did not** host the 2022 Commonwealth Games.
 
• **Durban **was initially awarded the** hosting rights** for the **2022 Commonwealth Games,** but they were later** stripped of the rights **due to financial difficulties, and the games were awarded to **Birmingham** instead.
 
• Hence, the **correct answer** is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​With **72 participating nations**, the 2022 Commonwealth Games were the **biggest** Commonwealth Games ever.
 
• Before **her passing** on **September 8** of that year, the occasion marked the final Commonwealth Games to be held while** Queen Elizabeth II** was alive.
